pages.title: Role in Progression
pages.text: From Deity Transformation onward, techniques reach laws, cross-realm power, True Spirits, ancient demons, the Immortal Realm, and endgame divine arts. Current rules data covers spatial rifts, cross-realm divine thought, demonization, True Demon Armor, Five-Element capture, chaos seals, True Spirit transformations, primordial thunder arts, and supreme body cultivation.

pages.title: Space and Cross-Realm Arts
pages.text: Illusory Celestial Phenomenon seals enemies in a temporary spatial rift. Shrinking Earth crosses a thousand li in one step; Cross-Void Divine Thought Grand Art projects divine thought between realms; and Chaos Sundering Heaven opens a chaotic space to imprison foes. All suit future spatial and realm-boundary systems.

pages.title: Ancient Demons, Buddhism, and Demon Clans
pages.text: Heavenly Wheel Demon Transformation Grand Art uses true demonic qi to transform its wielder, while True Demon Armor condenses protective demonic plate. Six Extremes True Demon Art creates a six-armed demon form; Radiant King Art turns from demon to Buddha; and the complete Three Brahma Sacred Art unites body cultivation, transformation, and divine arts.

pages.title: Five Elements, Radiance, and True Spirits
pages.text: Great Five Elements Immortal-Capturing Hand seizes mighty foes with an elemental hand. Northern Polar Origin Light pierces and tracks; Golden Magnetic Heavy Light combines gravity and magnetism; Asura Sacred Flame fuses several exotic fires; and Awakening of Insects Art blends twelve True Spirit bloodlines to assume their forms.

pages.title: Immortal-Realm and Law Methods
pages.text: The Five Thunder Orthodox Dharma Scripture is the Immortal Realm's root canon of thunder. Heavenly Baleful Prison-Suppressing Art and Great Strength Vajra Art are supreme body paths; Nine Nether Demon Eyes pierce illusions and restrictions; Great Five Elements Illusory World Art creates an elemental illusion realm; Azure Sea Heavenly Wave Art comprehends tidal law; and Profound Baleful Nether-Spirit Art drives baleful qi against immortal apertures.
